summary: Sibling of Carmela 'Mollie' Gianetta; John's great-grand-uncle/aunt.
bio:
Listed among Mollie's siblings in the FS tree (Savino 1897-1964, Mariano Martin 1899-1941, Maria 1902, Antonio 1907-1998, Giuseppe 1912-1971, Rosa 1914, Charles J. 1916-1975). The family lived in Dunmore (Ward 5) 1910-30.

Joseph married the girl next door: Vinchinza (Vincenza) Gillette of 135 Sand Street, a silk-mill hand. They married at St. Rocco's Catholic Church, Dunmore, on 17 June 1933 ([R4-S1]). The Gillette family had lived beside the Giannettas since at least 1910, when Tony Gillette's household is enumerated immediately before Francesco 'Janet''s on Sand Street ([R4-S2]).
sources: [R4-S1] Lackawanna Co. Orphans' Court, marriage license application No. 753 (1933): Joseph Genett (20, laborer, b. Dunmore, 133 Sand St; father Frank Genett, mother Angelica, maiden name 'Ferandina') and Vinchinza Gellette (20, silk hand, 135 Sand St; father Gaetano, deceased; mother Angeline Savino); sworn 27 May 1933; married 17 Jun 1933 at St. Rocco's Catholic Church, Dunmore, by Rev. Michele De Larno. Image attached to FamilySearch tree LCPG-XKM (index ark 1:1:VF7Z-FLR). (primary) https://ancestors.familysearch.org/service/tree/tree-data/published/sources/LCPG-XKM/images/i/1/image.jpg

[R4-S2] 1910 US census, Dunmore borough, Lackawanna Co., PA, ED 29 (reading uncertain), sheet 9B (21 Apr 1910), Sand Street no. 134: Francesco 'Janet' (41, married 14 years, alien, laborer for contractor), Angelico (30?, 4 children born, 4 living), Sam (12?), Marianna (son, 11), Marie (8), Tony (3), all born Italy.
